prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original atmospheric raster illustration for a Russian hotseat fantasy dice game, usable as a cropped start-screen panel and narrow dungeon banner.
Primary request: a polished hand-painted dark fantasy environment showing an ancient stone dungeon archway and a small ironbound treasure chest with a warm golden glow.
Scene/backdrop: a worn ancient stone chamber and vaulted doorway leading into mysterious deep midnight teal shadows. One amber wall torch warms the arch and nearby stone.
Style/medium: evocative late-1990s tabletop game box illustration, nuanced detailed painterly craftsmanship, richly textured stone and aged iron, sophisticated restrained brushwork.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2. The illuminated treasure chest and arched entrance occupy the right half, with the chest near the central-right area so it can survive horizontal banner crops. The left half is quieter dark stone, spacious and atmospheric. Clear large forms, carefully balanced illumination.
Lighting/mood: inviting adventure and quiet magical discovery, deep midnight teal shadows and warm amber gold light, dark but readable, not horror.
Constraints: environment artwork only, no page mockup, no interface, no text, no logos, no watermark, no dice, no people, no gore.
